raw.query: WITH d AS (SELECT run_id, experiment, pool, window_name, gpu, is_current, superseded_by FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current=true AND run_id IN ('srcbuild:llm_head2k_poly_src','srcbuild:llm_head2k_aic_src')), p AS (SELECT run_id, window_name, sla_metric, n_requests FROM provenance.v_pool_latency WHERE is_current=true AND run_id IN ('srcbuild:llm_head2k_poly_src','srcbuild:llm_head2k_aic_src')), c AS (SELECT variant_id, converter, mean_output_tok_per_user, ROUND(mean_output_tok_per_user::numeric,1) AS rounded_value, completed_requests, total_output_tokens, window_name, runtime, is_published FROM provenance.cost_model_variant WHERE family='head2k_src' AND converter IN ('poly','aic')) SELECT c.*, d.run_id, d.gpu, d.superseded_by, p.window_name AS latency_window, p.sla_metric, p.n_requests FROM c LEFT JOIN d ON d.run_id='srcbuild:llm_head2k_'||c.converter||'_src' LEFT JOIN p ON p.run_id=d.run_id ORDER BY c.converter,p.sla_metric
